name: Ca Na Xini (Hort Sant Patrici)
description: Eight rooms in the 1918 house of the Hort Sant Patrici estate, five minutes from Ferreries, among vineyards and gardens. It's the island's only hotel where you sleep inside a working DOP Mahón-Menorca cheese dairy and winery: you can visit the making, taste the house wine and breakfast on cheese made metres from your bed.

practicalInfo.acceso: Camí de Sant Patrici, about 5 minutes' drive from Ferreries.
practicalInfo.horario: Check the season and dates on the official website; the dairy and winery keep their own visiting hours.
practicalInfo.servicios: 8 rooms, seasonal outdoor pool, own DOP Mahón-Menorca cheese dairy and winery, vineyards and gardens.

seo.description: Ca Na Xini, Ferreries: an 8-room rural hotel on the Hort Sant Patrici estate, with its own DOP dairy and winery.
